slumpGraphs._comment: Per-player game-by-game diff history, for the ranking scene's slump graph (Version 2+). Leave a player's entry null/absent when real simulator output isn't available yet -- the renderer falls back to the simple rank/value display instead of fabricating a graph. Shape when available: rank1: [{ "game": 0, "diff": 0 }, { "game": 500, "diff": 1200 }, ...] sampled at regular game intervals up to gamesPerPlayer.

_v3_comment: Version 3+ theme: a single large-scale simulation run (totalGames), rather than N players x gamesPerPlayer. The automation pipeline is expected to write totalGames plus these result fields once a real 1000-man-game (or larger) run exists. Field names match what was requested for the future simulator-→JSON-→video pipeline.

v4._comment: Version 4: real simulator output (not test data), namespaced separately from the fields above so it never collides with V1-V3's keys in this shared demo file. A future automation pipeline would likely hand the video generator a JSON shaped like this object directly, without the version nesting.
